title: Event intake policy
description: DL-08: authenticated inbound event sources that may wake resident dots. Every source is HMAC-authenticated; tenant binding comes only from this policy, never from the payload.

signature_header.description: Lower-case HTTP header carrying the HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the raw body.

prefix.description: Literal prefix before the hex digest (for example 'sha256='). Empty when the header carries the bare digest.

secret_key.description: Secret-store key holding the shared HMAC secret. Restricted to the EVENT_INTAKE_ namespace so the policy cannot point verification at unrelated secrets.

tenant_slug.description: Binds every event of this source to one tenant; omitted means the system floor.

replay_window_hours.description: Payload-digest replay window in hours (default 24). Within it, a same-source event whose raw-body digest matches an earlier one is a duplicate regardless of its (unsigned) event type or delivery id. Senders that legitimately repeat identical bodies under different event types must lower it; 0 disables payload-digest dedupe, leaving only (source, delivery_id) dedupe.
